description: Retrieval Hit@K on 239 VULN functions across all three benchmarks (116 Sherlock + 110 DeFiHackLabs + 13 Web3Bugs). A unified structural gate-and-rank evaluation is applied consistently across all benchmarks.

type_only_hit_at_1_diagnostic.note: hit_at_1 for the gate-and-rank (mechaaudit) setting is computed on the full N=239 set: 89/239 = 0.3724 (paper Table VI: R@1=0.372). The type-only baseline's hit_at_1 was only measured on a 123-function diagnostic subset used during retrieval-gate calibration, not on the full N=239 set; full-set hit_at_1 for type-only was not computed. See the paper's Table VI footnote.
